messages:
Owen Phillips: Escalation coming in from FinchBank. They’re saying model behavior changed “overnight” w/ no notice + their pinned config *looks* unchanged. They’re seeing different answers + tool call formatting regressions.

Owen Phillips: I’m not seeing a corresponding model changelog entry in Console/docs for the version they claim they’re hitting. :eyes:

Owen Phillips: Filing as Jira: SUP-18455 https://jira.redwoodinference.com/browse/SUP-18455

Jira: SUP-18455 created by Owen Phillips

Dev Patel: thx. do we have request ids / timestamps from them?

Owen Phillips: Yep, added to the ticket. Example from their logs:
- route: `/v1/chat/completions`
- model: `rw/llama-3-70b-instruct`
- around 02:10–02:35 UTC
They’re also saying “we pinned” but when we asked what they pinned it’s the *alias* not a version.

Dev Patel: ok so could be alias rollout (expected) but the complaint is “no notice” => missing changelog entry or changelog not linked.

Dev Patel: @Quentin Harris can you check what version_id that alias resolved to before/after that window?

Quentin Harris: looking.

Quentin Harris: quick check in registry (internal): alias `rw/llama-3-70b-instruct` appears to have moved from `version_id=llama3-70b-instruct-2024-01-25` -> `...-2024-01-29` in that time range.

Quentin Harris: I don’t see a published changelog entry for `...-2024-01-29` yet. There *is* an internal metadata update event but it might’ve failed validation (deprecation fields?) so generator didn’t publish.

Owen Phillips: that matches what customer is describing. they’re also asking for “immutable release notes/audit trail” (standard enterprise change mgmt).

Dev Patel: ok action items:
1) confirm if generator/publish failed (and why)
2) get a customer-safe note published (even if minimal) + link it back to version
3) respond to customer w/ what changed + mitigation (pin exact version_id)

Dev Patel: @Chloe Martin can you check if Console changelog tab has anything for that version or if the feed endpoint returns draft only?

Chloe Martin: checking staging/prod now.

Chloe Martin: prod Console: model page shows changelog entries up to `...-2024-01-25` only. API `/control-plane/changelog?model_id=rw/llama-3-70b-instruct` returns empty for `...-2024-01-29` (no draft surfaced).

Chloe Martin: so yeah, looks like nothing published (not just UI).

Connor O'Brien: looping in. if there was an alias move, we should have a note even if it’s “rollout to new pinned version available” + compat notes. missing entry is a process gap.

Connor O'Brien: @Owen Phillips pls tell customer for now: pin exact `model_version` (we’ll provide the version_id) while we sort release note publishing.

Marissa Cole: Agree. Customer-facing wording needs to be careful: don’t mention internal rollout names, just “new model version published” + “may change outputs” + “compatibility: tool calling JSON constraints” etc.

Marissa Cole: Quentin can you summarize what actually changed between 2024-01-25 and 2024-01-29 builds? even a high-level (perf/kernel tweaks vs model weights vs safety settings).

Quentin Harris: from metadata diff (internal):
- quantization_profile changed `q4_kv` -> `q4_kv_v2` (runtime/kernel selection)
- default `tool_calling_mode` changed from `lenient` -> `strict_json`
- context window unchanged
- no weight change indicated (same base artifact hash)

Quentin Harris: the “tool formatting regression” is consistent w/ strict_json being enforced.

Dev Patel: that’s definitely changelog-worthy. We need a customer-safe note that says “tool calling output formatting is stricter” + “if you relied on lenient behavior, pin or adjust parsing.”

Owen Phillips: +1. they literally said “your tool calls started breaking our parser.”

Chloe Martin: any idea why generator didn’t publish? if there’s a validation failure we should fix it, but for now can we do a manual entry?

Connor O'Brien: I can do emergency publish path if we have approved text. but we should still fix pipeline so we don’t repeat.

Dev Patel: Let’s do both.

Marissa Cole: Proposed customer-facing bullets (draft):
- Change: Tool/function calling output is now stricter JSON for this model version.
- Impact: Integrations expecting non-JSON or loosely structured tool args may need to update parsing.
- Mitigation: Pin to previous version `...-2024-01-25` or update parsing; contact support for help.
- Compatibility: No change to context window.

Marissa Cole: Keep it short, no mention of quant profile unless we can phrase as “inference runtime optimization” w/o internals.

Quentin Harris: agreed. For the quantization change I’d phrase as “inference performance optimizations; no change to model weights” (if we’re confident).

Owen Phillips: for customer reply: I’ll share resolved version + how to pin exact version_id. Also acknowledge we missed posting release notes and we’re correcting.

Dev Patel: yep. make sure we don’t promise an SLA we don’t have. say “we’re publishing a release note entry” not “will never happen again.”

Connor O'Brien: I’ll take the publish action once we have final text + sign-off. @Marissa Cole can you drop final copy in SUP-18455?

Marissa Cole: will do now.

Chloe Martin: I’m going to open an internal bug: generator didn’t emit/publish note for a model metadata event (likely validation). Will link to SUP.

Dev Patel: thx. Owen, once published, update the ticket w/ changelog URL + close loop with customer.

Owen Phillips: ack. :thumbsup:

Owen Phillips: also FYI customer asked specifically for RSS/API feed. I told them “in progress” and linked them to our general updates page, but we should follow up once the public feed endpoint is ready.

Dev Patel: good call, add that request as product feedback in the ticket.

Quentin Harris: one more: if they pinned the alias, we should explicitly tell them alias can move during rollouts; pin version_id for change-control. maybe add that to the reply template.

Owen Phillips: yep, will do.

Connor O'Brien: ok I’m on standby for publish once text is in Jira.

Marissa Cole: posted final copy in SUP-18455 + tagged Connor for approval/publish.

Connor O'Brien: got it. pushing through emergency publish path now.
